rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the greatest extent or limit, as in pushing yourself to the max.

example.english: I’m going to push myself to the max today before I stop.
example.traditional: 我今日一定要操到極限先收工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 cou1 dou3 gik6 haan6 sin1 sau1 gung1
